series.title: The Return of Melchizedek
series.tagline: The priest-king who never left the page.
series.synopsis: Melchizedek appears once, blesses Abraham, and vanishes — yet he returns again and again at the hinges of the story. This flagship series follows the thread from Genesis 14 through the Psalms, Hebrews and the courts of heaven, and closes on the Kruptos Protocol: hidden things ferried forward.
